concept.title: Introduction to the Recipe Website
concept.shortdesc: An overview of the recipe website and its main features.

section.title: How to Use This Guide
section.p: This guide is organized by the main areas of the website. Use the sections below as a starting structure for adding detailed topics and task instructions.

ul.li: Account access: registration, login, and logout.
Recipe discovery: the home page, random recipes, and cuisine search.
Recipe details: viewing recipe information and ingredients.
Personal recipe space: favorites, custom recipes, and the dashboard.
Ingredient search: adding ingredients and finding matching recipes.

section.title: Home Page
section.p: The home page is available to guests and registered users. It provides a starting point for browsing recipes without requiring an account.

section.title: Random Recipes
section.p: The home page displays six randomly selected recipes. Select a recipe to open its details and learn more about its ingredients and preparation.

section.title: Search by Cuisine
section.p: Use the cuisine search to find recipes from a particular cuisine. Guests can browse the search results, while registered users can use the available personal features for recipes they discover.

section.title: Account Access

section.title: Recipe Details
section.p: Learn how to open a recipe, review its details, and understand its ingredients in the Viewing Recipe Details topic.

section.title: Personal Recipe Space
